The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Kres'ten'tarthi]] "[[Core name/Legends|Stent]]"<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> cut ties with his '''homeworld''' to serve [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref> "Thrawn" of the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Crisis of FaithD">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> Stent was serving the Grand Admiral as one of his [[TIE pilot|TIE starfighter pilots]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stent's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was mentioned in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
